push-before-merge.principle: Verify no unpushed local commits before merging or integrating a branch
push-before-merge.skip_reason: Not selected by user in this round

one-commit-per-bead.principle: Mixed working tree — one commit per bead, never `git add -A` across beads

audit-batch-sizing.principle: Cap audit passes at ~20 items with resumable intermediate progress

batch-clarifying-questions.principle: Ask multiple clarifying questions in a single AskUserQuestion call

snapshot-test-determinism.principle: Remove non-determinism (time, RNG, animation, environment) before asserting snapshots

verify-ci-from-config.principle: Verify which checks actually run against CI config and package manifest, not README/AGENTS.md
verify-ci-from-config.target: implementation-standard.md §Classify from code, not from memory

compositor-only-animation.principle: Animate only transform/opacity; no scroll-position polling; pause off-screen

disposable analysis output stays out of the repo (implementation-standard §Disposable analysis output)
one bead per independent cause (beads-workflow §Create a bead)
